description: Prices on one Yerevan street or block (quarter): median $/m² with p25–p75, new build vs resale, active listings, days on market, share of price cuts — for sale and rent, plus ~600 m segments of long streets (Komitas, Tigran Mets…) and the 5 buildings with most listings. Accepts names in Armenian, English, Russian, old names and typos. Every answer has n, window and fallback (radius500/district when the street has < 15 listings). Цены по улице.
